title: DAMP — Reserves & Reconciliation
description: The treasury view P3 exists to make possible: all three reconciliation legs, chain supply freshness, and whether the control itself is running. A green board here means USD-X is backed and somebody checked recently.

panels.title: Leg A — ledger vs chains
panels.description: Every token on a chain was issued here, and every token issued is on a chain or provably in transit. NO DATA means the leg has never been evaluated, which is not the same as passing.

panels.title: Leg B — the peg
panels.description: Reserve backing equals USD-X in circulation, 1:1. This is the only critical leg: a break means USD-X exists that nothing backs.

panels.title: Leg C — custodian
panels.description: An inequality, not an equality: the custodian holding more than the ledger expects is unminted headroom. Only a shortfall is a break. NOT EVALUATED means no custodian has ever reported — the state this platform was permanently in before P3.

panels.title: Drift by leg
panels.description: Signed, in each leg's own smallest units. The shape matters more than the value: a steady drift is a bookkeeping error, a growing one is a leak.

panels.title: Open breaks
panels.description: A break is a condition with a lifetime, not an event: the same shortfall seen on twelve runs is one row. This is a work queue an operator can finish.

panels.title: Last reconciled
panels.description: The most important panel on this board. A reconciliation that has stopped running produces no breaks, which looks exactly like a healthy platform everywhere else.

panels.title: Indexer cursor lag
panels.description: Expected to sit flat at the confirmation depth. A rising line means the indexer has stopped advancing, and Leg A begins comparing against a frozen supply figure.

panels.title: Custodian statement age
panels.description: How old the balance Leg C is evaluating against is. A leg passing against yesterday's figure is worse than one failing, because it is actively reassuring.

panels.title: Orphaned events
panels.description: R9. A non-zero value on a chain the platform mints against means a ledger credit may be backed by a transaction that no longer exists.

panels.title: Outbox backlog
panels.description: Nothing is ever lost — that is what the outbox is for — but a queue that only grows means every downstream consumer is working from an increasingly old view.
